scenario: A costly request starts shortly before month end, pauses for a long test, then resumes next month; its final usage counter arrives late.
mechanism: Assigning eventual task severity to start date or treating late reported usage as future continuation advances or duplicates spending across finance periods.
detection: Preserve occurrence interval, source reporting convention, observed-at timestamp, request start and state transitions; compare accrued and reported-time views.
response: Forecast only increments inside the target interval; keep late-incurred nowcast separate; expose ambiguous occurrence intervals instead of inventing uniform accrual.
test_assertion: For a deterministic fixture with dated invocation increments, month totals sum to the lifetime total with each invocation counted once; late arrival changes observed completeness but not the documented occurrence-time assignment.
residual_limit: A provider that supplies only completion timestamps cannot support exact within-call accrual without an explicit convention.
owner: Backend usage normalization and forecasting target owner

scenario: A session remains open overnight awaiting the human; on return it incurs a large uncached prefix under a changed cache policy.
mechanism: Open-session count is mistaken for continuous token production, while the resumed-request severity model assumes a warm cache.
detection: Separate human-wait intervals from model-running state; record preceding gap, cached/uncached usage and known cache-policy/version metadata.
response: Use state-dependent resumption and resource marks; treat a new user task as an arrival in an existing context, not continuous autonomous work.
test_assertion: An observed waiting interval contributes no fabricated model usage; resumed invocation uses its actual cache category and is assigned once regardless of whether conversation ID persists.
residual_limit: Cache eviction is often externally unobserved; a gap is a predictive feature, not proof of a specific retention rule.

scenario: Context compacts while the local cumulative counter resets after a runtime restart, and the source re-emits the last pre-restart event.
mechanism: Context shrinkage becomes negative incurred usage, a reset delta becomes zero or a giant positive jump, or the replayed event duplicates spending.
detection: Keep context length separate from cumulative resource counters, persist counter epoch and event identity, and flag decreasing cumulative counters.
response: Normalize usage within validated counter epochs; quarantine ambiguous reset gaps; represent compaction as a state change with any separately observed summarizer usage.
test_assertion: Compaction never reduces already-incurred usage; replay is idempotent; known post-reset increments remain countable without silently assuming missing pre-reset usage was zero.
residual_limit: Unlogged reset boundaries can leave a bounded or unknown increment rather than an exact value.
requirement_source: backend-plan.md acceptance checks; ai-spend-master-plan.md repeated cumulative counter warning; 16-S07

scenario: A user forks a conversation with copied historical telemetry, retries a failed request on another machine, and both branches execute new model calls.
mechanism: Shared history is billed twice or legitimate retry work is deduplicated merely because task text matches; independent roots inflate human arrival counts.
detection: Retain invocation/source IDs, machine/source namespaces, lineage and inherited-event metadata; distinguish semantic task identity from physical execution identity.
response: Deduplicate copied historical invocations only; count genuinely distinct billable executions; preserve related-branch groups for evaluation and dependence modeling.
test_assertion: Forked historical events have one incurred total, while new child and retry invocations all remain in totals; train/test splits keep known related branches together.
residual_limit: Without provider invocation IDs or lineage, exact overlap may be unresolved; do not merge based only on similar text.
requirement_source: backend-plan.md idempotent ingestion; master plan explicit attribution; 16-S04 session-linkage limitation

scenario: One person starts several requests before a deadline; shared provider quotas queue or reject calls and automatic retries resume after the forecast boundary.
mechanism: Summing unconstrained session rate forecasts overstates near-term usage and underestimates later retry bursts; active session count conflates waiting and execution.
detection: Capture running/waiting states, rejection reason, retry events and known shared quota scope; inspect overlapping intervals and completion delays.
response: Condition near-term continuation on observed capacity state where available; simulate shared delay shocks rather than independent request timelines; retain a quota-unknown scenario.
test_assertion: A fixture with queued nonbillable requests produces no invented model tokens until invocation; distinct billable retry calls are counted and timed correctly.
residual_limit: Undisclosed provider queues and unreported failed-call charging prevent exact pre-call cost timing.
owner: Session state and forecast simulation owners
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md future projection assumptions; 16-S02 timing evidence

scenario: The telemetry collector crashes disproportionately on very long expensive sessions; coverage begins mid-request for replacement machines.
mechanism: Closed-only training overrepresents short cheap runs; unknown initial ages become zero; coverage loss is misclassified as successful termination.
detection: Maintain independent collector coverage and heartbeat state, end-reason provenance, last-observed event, known or unknown start age, and unresolved terminal statuses. Check distinct source capabilities for daily totals, session summaries, identified prefixes, live state and availability provenance, plus freshness.
response: Represent right censoring, left truncation and unknown age separately; compare complete-case results to missingness sensitivity scenarios; fall back to aggregates when linkage is unreliable. Aggregates/finalized summaries alone cannot enable live continuation; failed coverage/freshness gates select the daily fallback.
test_assertion: A collector-loss record remains unknown/censored rather than completed with zero future usage; restarting observation does not reset known request age or duplicate prior increments. An aggregate-only source or stale snapshot cannot activate the live continuation model.
residual_limit: Informative censoring may remain unidentifiable without an independent billing source; survival-model assumptions must be reported.
requirement_source: frontend-plan.md missing data must not become zero; 16-S08

scenario: An evaluation uses task category inferred from final logs, final success status, or realized future model mix at an early prefix; sibling prefixes appear in training. A normalized round starts before a cutoff but its tool result and token_count report arrive after it.
mechanism: The estimator receives future behavior and related outcomes that would not exist at forecast time, overstating usable accuracy. Filtering by earliest round timestamp exposes final usage, result size/status and tool latency before those fields exist.
detection: Require available-at timestamps for all features, preserve extraction version and source cutoff, and group related request/fork IDs before splitting. Track field-level supporting report/result events, CLI/turn-ID behavior, pinned dataset release and extractor/schema.
response: Recompute features from truncated source prefixes; use future unknown covariates only as explicit scenarios; keep all prefixes of a request in the same partition. Mask final usage and result-derived fields until supporting events; preserve original ingestion times where available. Otherwise label event-time prefix simulation, not original arrival/source-delay replay.
test_assertion: Changing suffix events after the forecast cutoff cannot change the stored prefix feature vector or prediction inputs; a grouped split contains no shared request lineage. At a cutoff between tool emission and later result/usage report, tool request is visible but final usage, result status/size and latency are absent; re-normalization cannot reveal them retrospectively.
residual_limit: Unknown cross-account retries and semantic duplicates can still leak correlated tasks across groups. Event timestamps alone cannot reconstruct original ingestion delays.
requirement_source: Forecast research boundary and evidence standard; 16-S08 and 16-S06; 16-S03 README data format; r04 telemetry cross-review

scenario: A user changes model, reasoning effort and permission mode mid-session while a harness update changes compaction behavior; the export labels the whole session using its final model.
mechanism: Historical usage is repriced with the wrong model and future severity uses an obsolete workflow regime; missing effort is silently interpreted as low effort.
detection: Prefer step-level model/configuration events and versioned alias mapping; compare session summary labels against per-invocation metadata and track unknown feature values.
response: Split configuration epochs while retaining session lineage; apply time-valid rates by invocation; widen uncertainty or use pooled fallback for unseen regimes.
test_assertion: Earlier invocations retain original model/rate after a later switch; absent effort remains unknown; a change in config is reflected only from its observed effective point onward.
residual_limit: Some products hide routing or effort; a single opaque plan label cannot identify the real execution configuration.
owner: Usage contract, pricing and session feature owners
requirement_source: mentor-discussion.txt lines 102-115; ai-spend-master-plan.md usage versus cost distinction; 16-S01 and 16-S07

scenario: A production incident simultaneously increases request arrivals, expensive debugging severity, retries and cross-team concurrency, then subsides after mitigation.
mechanism: Independent count/severity forecasts and independent team sampling miss tail risk; a Hawkes model mistakes the common incident for persistent self-excitation.
detection: Inspect conditional severity versus count, residual cross-team correlation and known incident timing using only available evidence; compare common-shock and excitation models.
response: Use joint count/mark or shared calendar-shock simulations and scenario conditioning; evaluate a non-exciting baseline; derive aggregate quantiles from joint sampled totals.
test_assertion: Synthetic dependent fixtures distinguish E[sum severity|N] from independent mean multiplication; summed sample paths reproduce dependence and do not use sums of marginal quantiles as company quantiles.
residual_limit: Unannounced incidents remain unpredictable; correct dependence representation does not guarantee accurate incident arrival forecasts.
requirement_source: Master plan company/team forecasts with limitations; 16-S09; coordination with track 07

scenario: An additive hybrid combines a daily total forecast with full unfinished-request continuation; the daily target already contains that continuation, while a late provider correction overlaps telemetry.
mechanism: Unfinished-work usage and late-incurred observations are counted in multiple components, biasing totals upward despite individually calibrated component forecasts.
detection: Define request-start and occurrence-time partitions at each forecast cutoff; audit target provenance, observed invocation keys and component ownership.
response: Active component predicts only future increments from requests started by the cutoff; arrival component predicts increments from later starts; late-incurred nowcast is disjoint. Keep daily totals as standalone comparator or feature-enriched model if partition is unavailable.
test_assertion: For a fixture with an ongoing request, a future request and a late usage correction, each covered increment belongs to exactly one component; component totals reconcile to the target and cannot add full continuation to a total-demand baseline.
residual_limit: Unidentified request starts or uncertain occurrence intervals may prevent an exact partition; disable the additive hybrid rather than assume disjointness.
owner: Forecast target, reconciliation and hybrid model owners
requirement_source: ai-spend-master-plan.md observed/forecast distinctions; 16 target formula; r04 telemetry cross-review
